source_snapshot.procedure: Load ras_enable=1; retain UMC precheck; run block5/subtype1/type2 mode0 LCRC TX then mode1 LCRC RX.
source_snapshot.criteria: Each succeeds, driver/AER evidence matches AMD GPU RAS Tool guide Table3.13.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL conflates severity and omits direction isolation.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Preserves both LCRC directions, target BDF, AER and link health.

old_problem: Implicit GPU/BDF/root-port mapping, proprietary Table3.13 mode direction semantics, direction-specific AER oracle, inter-phase stop gate and PCIe recovery require approval.
disposition_reason: The source intentionally covers two correctable directions. ED-19 forbids collapsing them, and ED-16 requires the vendor mode mapping and link recovery before either phase can run or pass. A successful second command cannot repair missing evidence from the first phase.
decision_basis: Directly read Reliability row200 all18 XLSX cells and history2581.
Preserved separate mode0 TX and mode1 RX stimuli, Table3.13, per-phase AER evidence and rebaseline.
Kept the source UMC-zero query as ancillary only; it does not validate the PCIe link.
No injection, module change or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD PCIe correctable LCRC TX and RX phase-isolated validation
test_case.purpose: Prove correctable LCRC handling independently in transmit and receive directions without device loss, link degradation or continuing AER.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras version/hash/license and matching driver
AMD GPU RAS Tool guide Table3.13 or signed equivalent
GPU UUID/OAM/BDF, endpoint/root-port and link mapping
Direction-specific AER/status/counter oracle and quiet window
Approved PCIe/GPU reset or reboot recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records endpoint/root-port AER, enumeration and link baseline, validates target and Table3.13, runs `sudo amdgpuras -b 5 -s 1 -t 2 -m 0` once, collects TX-specific evidence and proves a quiet healthy link; only after an approved rebaseline runs `sudo amdgpuras -b 5 -s 1 -t 2 -m 1` once and repeats RX-specific evidence and health checks.
test_case.expected_result: Each isolated phase reports success and produces the approved direction-specific correctable AER/driver evidence; the GPU remains enumerated, link width/speed recover and no AER storm or hang remains.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both phases independently pass their exact oracle and recovery. Missing first-phase evidence, running phases without rebaseline, wrong direction, device loss, link downgrade or ongoing AER fails/blocks the case.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle GPU PCIe SUT and explicit two-phase approval.
Confirm endpoint/root-port/BDF and Table3.13 modes before phase one.
Stop before RX if TX evidence, quiet window or health is not clean.
One attempt per phase; no automatic retry/reset.
expected_evidence: Pre-phase endpoint/root-port AER and lspci baseline
Separate mode0 TX output and attributable evidence
Approved rebaseline plus separate mode1 RX output/evidence
Per-phase quiet windows and final enumeration/link health
test_case.recovery: On unexpected severity, device loss, hang, link downgrade or AER storm, stop the sequence, preserve phase evidence and use only approved PCIe/GPU/OOB recovery; verify enumeration and link health before any separately authorized phase.

source_conflict.reason: Primary source consistently specifies correctable LCRC TX mode0 and RX mode1; DeepSeek's mixed-severity wording is a review defect.
